accuracyFlags: Sections 04 and 08 and the first FAQ state flatly 'up to twelve months from your date of arrival... After twelve months you must convert' while section 01 says 18 months (until 31 Oct 2026) then 12 months from 1 November 2026: the page contradicts itself. NZTA's rule depends on the arrival date: last arrival before 1 Nov 2026 keeps 18 months, on/after is 12 months
Section 01 wording 'From 1 November 2026, that car-licence period reduces to 12 months' omits that it depends on date of last arrival and that leaving and re-entering restarts the clock

Class 1 'up to 6,000 kg' is correct for GLW but 'overseas licence generally aligns' needs the NZTA source for class equivalence; claim that 'some countries are recognised for no-test conversion' is undated
